name: FindYoWay
tagline: AI-powered navigation for the blind and visually impaired
summary: A cross-platform mobile app that helps visually impaired users navigate independently, combining outdoor GPS routing, indoor floor-plan navigation, real-time obstacle detection, and a Gemini-powered vision assistant that reads signs and answers questions aloud.

components.name: backend/
components.description: Python Flask server that proxies/orchestrates Gemini API calls

components.name: dashboard/
components.description: React + Vite web dashboard for venues to register floor plans

notableDecisions: On-device vs. cloud AI split: obstacle detection runs on-device (TensorFlow.js + COCO-SSD) for low latency; sign reading and conversational Q&A go through Gemini Vision for deeper reasoning where latency is more tolerable.
API key and prompt logic kept server-side in Flask rather than called directly from the mobile client.
AsyncStorage used for offline caching so the app degrades gracefully without network signal.

keyFeatures: Live sign reading via Gemini Vision

challenges.title: Latency-critical vs. accuracy-critical tradeoff
challenges.description: Needed obstacle warnings to be near-instant while allowing sign-reading/Q&A to take longer for better accuracy, driving the on-device/cloud AI split.

challenges.title: Offline resilience
challenges.description: Designed caching (AsyncStorage) so navigation doesn't fully break when connectivity drops.
